errors.text_span: The bars are not grouped or stacked
errors.evidence: The bars are visually grouped. For each benchmark category on the x-axis, there is a cluster of three bars representing the three different models. This is the definition of a grouped bar chart.

errors.text_span: 浅蓝色代表GRPO-7B，浅灰蓝色代表Qwen-2.5-VL-7B
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors to models. In the chart, GRPO-7B is represented by a medium blue color, but the description calls it '浅蓝色' (light blue). Qwen-2.5-VL-7B is represented by a light blue color, but the description calls it '浅灰蓝色' (light grey-blue). This incorrectly describes the colors and swaps the visual identities of the two models.

The bars are grouped side-by-side for each benchmark category (a grouped bar chart), not arranged vertically. 'Vertikal angeordnete Balken' (vertically arranged bars) is an incorrect description of the chart's structure.
